title: HO-FL: Hybrid-Order Federated Learning for Heterogeneous Edge Devices
abstract: arXiv:2609.39074v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) on memory-constrained edge devices faces a dilemma: first-order (FO) optimization (i.e., backpropagation) demands substantial memory, whereas zeroth-order (ZO) optimization suffers from severe convergence slowdown. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce HO-FL, a hybrid-order FL framework that trains a model's bottom segment with ZO optimization and its top segment with FO optimization. Each device can flexibly select its order boundary according to its memory budget while participating in the training of the same global model. Moreover, our convergence analysis reveals a new, fundamental trade-off: clients with larger FO-trained segments can provide more accurate updates, but favoring them can underrepresent other clients' data. translated_title: HO-FL：面向异构边缘设备的混合阶联邦学习
translated_abstract: 在内存受限的边缘设备上进行联邦学习（FL）面临一个困境：一阶（FO）优化（即反向传播）需要大量内存，而零阶（ZO）优化则存在严重的收敛放缓问题。为了解决这一困境，我们提出了HO-FL，一种混合阶联邦学习框架，它使用零阶优化训练模型的底部部分，使用一阶优化训练模型的顶部部分。每台设备可以根据自身的内存预算灵活选择其阶数边界，同时参与同一个全局模型的训练。此外，我们的收敛分析揭示了一个新的、根本性的权衡：拥有较大一阶训练部分的客户端可以提供更精确的更新，但偏向这些客户端可能会导致其他客户端的数据代表性不足。我们将这一权衡与实际多步本地更新的偏差和方差联系起来，从而得到一个采样优化问题以及一种实用的维度感知近似方法，可直接……
tldr: 提出HO-FL混合阶联邦学习框架，通过零阶优化训练模型底层、一阶优化训练模型顶层，让内存受限的异构边缘设备可按自身预算灵活选择阶数边界共同训练同一全局模型，并揭示了客户端一阶部分大小带来的更新精度与数据代表性之间的权衡及相应的采样优化方案。
en_tdlr: HO-FL is a hybrid-order federated learning framework that trains the bottom segment with zeroth-order and the top segment with first-order optimization, enabling memory-constrained heterogeneous edge devices to flexibly choose order boundaries while training the same global model, and it reveals a fundamental trade-off between update accuracy and client representation, yielding a sampling optimization problem with a practical dimension-aware approximation.
